$$V^{\otimes m} \cong \bigoplus_{\substack{\mu \vdash m \\ \ell(\mu) \leq n}} L(\mu) \otimes S_\mu$$

$$\mu_i = a_i + a_{i+1} + \cdots + a_{n-1} \quad (i = 1, \ldots, n-1), \qquad \mu_n = 0.$$

The size of this partition is:
